scope: Controlled 60-tick density pulse using two passive neighbors pinned 12 units to either side for ticks 13–36 and 80 units away otherwise. This produces crowding without contact repulsion (range 10). Neighbors track the subject position, fixing the cue independently of its motion. Normal costs, no sunlight or reproduction; three slots already occupied. A manipulated-input assay, not spontaneous behavior or a fitness test.
